explanation: This component is 0 at every D1 and GO step and at all steps before about trial 90. It fires only at D2 in the last ten trials after choosing a1: about 2-3 around trials 90-93 and 6-8 in trials 94-99, rising to 9-10 when the a1 choice followed an unrewarded trial and reached S1 by the common route (a rare trip to S2 gives about 6-8).
